# [A1 — Danish land-based nitrogen load](../hypodrafts/A1.md "Danish land-based nitrogen load")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_a1.py`: what the published record and the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository reads the published vintages of the national load account or compares them.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-NEEDS">[A1](../hypodrafts/A1.md "Danish land-based nitrogen load") predicts that the deficit scales with current-year nitrogen load, and needs catchment nitrogen flux per water body per month; this project holds none — see *Still blocked*.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-NEEDS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-PRECONDITION">What **can** be tested is a precondition. The agricultural share in circulation, [69.6](../SOURCES.md#F-e2cc286a52)%, is a residual, and a residual cannot be checked against itself; it can be checked across revisions of the account ([`../RESIDUAL.md`](../RESIDUAL.md)). This page drafts that test against the published reports.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-PRECONDITION "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The model's input, in DCE's words

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-INPUT">DCE's DK-QNP model computes the diffuse nitrogen load from the part of the country without measuring stations — *"en model for det resterende umålte opland"* — and the methods chapter of *Vandløb 2018* (`SR353`, Thodsen and colleagues, 2019) names the annually computed field-level nitrogen surplus as an important model variable:</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-INPUT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

> "En vigtig modelvariabel i DK-QNP modellen til beregning af tilførsel af total
> diffus kvælstof er det årligt beregnede kvælstofoverskud på 'mark-niveau'."

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-BLICHER">The field balance behind it is computed as Blicher-Mathiesen and colleagues (2015) describe.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-BLICHER "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-RELATION">The report's sixth chapter then offers, as a result:</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-RELATION "What this claim rests on")</sup>

> "Der er således – for perioden som helhed - en meget stærk, signifikant lineær
> relation mellem det nationale markoverskud og den samlede, normaliserede
> kvælstoftransport fra diffuse kilder (Figur [6.7](../SOURCES.md#F-5d7e2cb146), D)."

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-CIRCULAR">A farming statistic is an input to the model that generates the diffuse load over the ungauged part of the country, and its correlation with that load is then reported as evidence — class `7`, model-as-datum, in [the taxonomy of data-stream errors](https://github.com/Jjokulian/statistical-methods#7b-rate-a-data-stream-by-the-errors-it-can-contain). This does not show the attribution is wrong. It shows that Figur [6.7](../SOURCES.md#F-5d7e2cb146) D cannot be what shows it is right.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-CIRCULAR "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Observable consequence, stated so it can be falsified

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-VINTAGES">DCE recompute the series with each report. SR353 runs the national water model over the whole period from 1990 in each reporting year, *"således at den nyeste version af modellen anvendes"*, puts its diffuse nitrogen load [8](../SOURCES.md#F-240e5ebce1)% lower on average than by the old method, and says the normalised loads of earlier reports are not directly comparable with the new. So a fixed year *y* exists in more than one published vintage, not always with the same value.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-VINTAGES "What this claim rests on")</sup>

> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-PARTITION">If a version change moves a part **P** out of the leftover, and the account is a partition, then **R_new(y) = R_old(y) − P** and **T_new(y) = T_old(y)**.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-PARTITION "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-FALSIFY">**Falsified if:** R does not move; R moves by materially less than P; or the **total** T moves instead, with no declared change to explain it. Any of the three means the published share is not a share of a partition.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-FALSIFY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Data, named and counted

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-VINTAGE-FILES">DCE publish each report as `Vandløb <year>. NOVANA` at `https://dce2.au.dk/pub/SR<n>.pdf`: `SR353` is *Vandløb 2018* and `SR527` *Vandløb 2021*, both pinned here, and the text of each extracts.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-VINTAGE-FILES "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-FIGURES">**SR353's figures.** The 2018 load from land to the coast is about [50,000](../SOURCES.md#F-ff662f3a7e) t N and point sources about [5,200](../SOURCES.md#F-9bf0e10033) t N, computed from [209](../SOURCES.md#F-b6474e2555) coastal stream stations and a model for the unmeasured catchment; the runoff rests on [240](../SOURCES.md#F-3a2fedf01e) gauging stations in *Vandløb 2018*, against [179](../SOURCES.md#F-1dc26c8976) in *Vandløb 2016* and [201](../SOURCES.md#F-3dfe456756) in *Vandløb 2017*; the field surplus ran between [186,000](../SOURCES.md#F-897bba09c9) and [240,000](../SOURCES.md#F-897bba09c9) t N over the latest [5](../SOURCES.md#F-80967ba978) agrohydrological years.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-FIGURES "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-NETWORK">So the runoff rests on more stations in each of these reports than in the one before, and a change of vintage can move the total for reasons the report declares — which the test must set aside before it reads its third failure mode.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-NETWORK "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-HOV">`data/raw/national/hovedoplande.geojson` holds [24](../SOURCES.md#F-cbc46638de) main catchments, among them `DK` *Int vidå-kruså* beside `DK4.1` *Vidå-kruså*: a catchment named as international beside its Danish part.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-HOV "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-SERIES">`docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` holds [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-7769a94f7a) station-month values summed over its [9](../SOURCES.md#F-cb09ee93d7) variables ([60,460](../SOURCES.md#F-fdde9e7c79) to [84,668](../SOURCES.md#F-f2e801ebf6) per variable), from [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-d519303f1a) stations over [564](../SOURCES.md#F-f27c348866) months from [1980](../SOURCES.md#F-44433af5f2). Its variables are temperature, salinity, oxygen and oxygen saturation at surface and bed, and fluorescence: **no nutrients**.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-SERIES "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-CTD">`data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` is [448,723,078](../SOURCES.md#F-b047e411d7) bytes with [34](../SOURCES.md#F-6c253b945d) columns and [53,710,760](../SOURCES.md#F-4df017f985) rows; its parameters include temperature, salinity, oxygen, fluorescence and turbidity, and none is a nutrient.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-CTD "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-KEMI">`data/raw/oda/kemi.csv.gz`, the ODA water-chemistry extract, is held: [1,805,827](../SOURCES.md#F-9fa9c3c21c) rows, with total nitrogen on [190,473](../SOURCES.md#F-a17c9263d9), nitrite+nitrate on [182,399](../SOURCES.md#F-bcdb046417) and ammonium on [181,647](../SOURCES.md#F-b13ba625e6) — nitrogen **in the sea**, a state and a response, not a load from land.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-KEMI "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-USED">Only the published reports are used by the test. The held monitoring files are what [A1](../hypodrafts/A1.md "Danish land-based nitrogen load") would otherwise be tested on: the station panel and the CTD carry no nitrogen, and the water chemistry carries it as a concentration in the sea.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-USED "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null under the constraint imposed

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-NULL">The constraint is **arithmetic identity across two publications**, not sampling: there is no estimator distribution, and n is the number of version changes, which is small. The only noise under the null is publication rounding, computed here rather than quoted.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-NULL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-ROUNDING">SR353 gives the total as *ca.* [50,000](../SOURCES.md#F-ff662f3a7e) t and the point sources as *ca.* [5,200](../SOURCES.md#F-9bf0e10033) t. Read as rounded at their last non-zero digit — units of [1,000](../SOURCES.md#F-208b4809e6) t and [100](../SOURCES.md#F-8c9c7d9cf6) t — each lies within half a unit: h = [500](../SOURCES.md#F-59c69efc6e) t on the total and h = [50](../SOURCES.md#F-1a65bf49a3) t on the point sources. Four published quantities enter each comparison (T_old, T_new, P_old, P_new):</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-ROUNDING "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-BOUND">worst case: [500](../SOURCES.md#F-59c69efc6e) + [500](../SOURCES.md#F-59c69efc6e) + [50](../SOURCES.md#F-1a65bf49a3) + [50](../SOURCES.md#F-1a65bf49a3) = **[1,100](../SOURCES.md#F-33522ad347) t N**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-BOUND "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-SD">if the four rounding errors are independent and uniform: a standard deviation of **[410](../SOURCES.md#F-42ecae4a8d) t N**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-SD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-REJECT">The test takes the worst case. **Reject only when |ΔR + P| > [1,100](../SOURCES.md#F-33522ad347) t N** — which is also the design's honest limit: **no power against reallocations under [1,100](../SOURCES.md#F-33522ad347) t N**, beside a point-source term of [5,200](../SOURCES.md#F-9bf0e10033) t. More power needs the underlying tables at full precision, not the report text.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-REJECT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-ACTUAL">Use the **actual** (*aktuel*) series, never the climate-normalised one: normalisation is a model applied to the total, and its method changed with SR353 — the new method conserves mass, so that over the whole period from 1990 the normalised and the actual load are equal, while by the old method the normalised values ran [1](../SOURCES.md#F-77d48a4848)% above the actual over 1990–2017. It moves T by itself between vintages and would contaminate the third failure mode.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-ACTUAL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-P1">Fetch the `Vandløb <year> NOVANA` vintages 2013-2024, one PDF each, streamed to disk, then extracted locally with `pdftotext -layout`; `SR353` and `SR527` are pinned already.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-P2">From each, for every *y* ≥ 1990: total land→coast TN, point sources, diffuse remainder — actual, not normalised.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-P3">Read each vintage's methods chapter for declared changes. SR353 declares a regional bias correction of the modelled load from unmeasured catchments, new that year (*"Bias-korrektionen … er ny i forhold til de foregående år"*); a correction of TN and TP measured in 2016 and the first [4](../SOURCES.md#F-30e388bced) months of 2017 with a wrong analytical method; a restoration of TN measured by one laboratory in 2007–2014; and a new runoff model for the unmeasured catchments.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-P3-NOTP">Each of these changes the total itself, not a part of it: a declared change of this kind is expected to move T, so it is set aside before the third failure mode is read. The candidates for *P* are changes that count a source apart from the diffuse load, as scattered dwellings are not today.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-P3-NOTP "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-P4">For each candidate, form ΔR and ΔT across the vintage boundary and compare them with the [1,100](../SOURCES.md#F-33522ad347) t bound.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What a result would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-WOULD">**Would.** [3](../SOURCES.md#F-558e4ac7d9) or more declared changes with ΔR = −P inside the bound and ΔT inside it license one narrow statement: *the account behaves as a partition under revision.* A single failure of the third kind — T moving with R, with no declared change to explain it — licenses the opposite and stronger one: the share is circular.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-WOULD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-WOULDNOT">**Would not.** Nothing here licenses a claim about the sea: no mechanism, no nitrogen-load coefficient, no oxygen.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-WOULDNOT "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-BOX">Nor whether *Denmark* is a closed box: the national catchment layer names the transboundary unit outright, and whether the account carries a term for what flows in from across the border is not established — the pinned SR353 does not mention Germany. A partition that balances is still a partition of a quantity whose boundary was assumed.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-BOX "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Still blocked, and by what exactly

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-FETCH">The river-transport series that carry [A1](../hypodrafts/A1.md "Danish land-based nitrogen load")'s load term — ODA's *Vandløb / Stoftransport / Månedstransport* and *Næringsstoftilførsel til havet* (`ODA-STOFTRANSPORT` and `ODA-TILFOERSEL` in the source register) — are not fetchable by `scripts/fetch_oda.py` as it stands: its `TOPICS` are all under the marine root, and `run()` opens the topic tree at `topic.aspx?id=h&t=h`, that root, so they need a code change, not merely a table entry.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-FETCH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-BA-A1-WARNING">And the warning: the water chemistry is nitrogen **concentration in the sea**, a state and a response. Substituting it for a land load would put a response in the place of its driver.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-BA-A1-WARNING "What this claim rests on")</sup>
